messages:
Evelyn Byrd: Hey everyone! Evelyn here — joined yesterday as SWE on infra. Got my MDM laptop but I'm hitting a roadblock: VPN won't authenticate and I can't clone the private repos. Who should I ping to get network + repo access? Also hi 👋 I keep bees and have jars of honey if anyone's into snacks 🍯

Jordan Park: Welcome Evelyn!! :tada: Ping @it-help for VPN and @platform-team for repo perms. For GitHub, add your SSH key to your profile (Settings -> SSH and GPG keys) and post the key in the ticket.

Marta Lin: Hi Evelyn — congrats and welcome to infra. For MDM specifically, open an IT ticket at https://redwood.internal/it/ticket and include your machine serial and the MDM invite email. If you want to try the quick enroll, run:
```
sudo /usr/local/bin/redwood-mdm enroll
```
and then check the status with `redwood-mdm status`.

DevExBot: MDM enrollment workflow initiated for user Evelyn Byrd. An invite link was emailed to evelyn@redwood.example — reply to this thread if you don't see it in 10 minutes. :robot_face:

Sam Wells: FYI platform-team needs your GitHub username and the name of the repo group (e.g., redwood-internal). I can add you to the repo if @marta doesn't have the fast path. Also we have a few spare mechanical keyboard switches in the office if you want a tactile keyboard — DM me. :keyboard:

Evelyn Byrd: Thanks Jordan/Marta/Sam! I'll open the IT ticket now and paste my SSH pubkey there. GitHub username is evelyn-byrd. Also the repo group is `infra-core`. And yes please @Sam if there's a spare for switches — I'm partial to Gateron Browns.

Priya Rao: Welcome! If you need access to internal Slack channels, ping me and I can invite you to #eng-infra and #infra-builds. Also very into the honey trade — count me in for a jar. :honey_pot:

Evelyn Byrd: Appreciate it all. Small logistics Q: who issues VPN certs for macOS? The MDM enroll step hung for me once and I needed to re-run the command.

Marta Lin: VPN certs are provisioned by IT after enrollment. If enroll hangs, send a screenshot of the terminal + output of `redwood-mdm status` to the ticket; we usually force-refresh the profile from the server.

Jordan Park: If anything blocks after the ticket, @Sam and I can jump on a quick Zoom. Also welcome party this Friday 4pm — bring a fun fact. (Evelyn — bee fact counts!) :beers:

Evelyn Byrd: Ha! Fun fact incoming: my bees helped pollinate a community garden that grows hot peppers. I always bring something spicy. Looking forward to Friday and to getting the VPN sorted. Thanks everyone! :wave:
